reviewed_sources.title: CrossBFM: Distilling a Shared Latent Behavior Space Across Humanoid Embodiments
reviewed_sources.verification_level: Abstract, submission history, selected method/experiment/appendix sections and author project page; no implementation execution or reproduction.
reviewed_sources.notes: Frozen G1 source model and matched retargeted human-motion frames yield a shared behavior space. Section 4.4 still trains a PPO tracker per robot. Targets M3, T1, N1; no verified Agibot support. Joint-reference tracking is somewhat more accurate in reported comparisons.

reviewed_sources.title: Predictive Safety Curricula for Robust Legged Locomotion
reviewed_sources.verification_level: Abstract, submission history, method section 2.5, selected experiments and limitations; not reproduced.
reviewed_sources.notes: Separate distributional safety critic prioritizes contexts and reuses environment event realizations. PPO policy loss and task reward remain fixed. This is not arbitrary off-policy trajectory replay. ANYmal-D/X quadrupeds; omitted safety costs remain a limitation.
reviewed_sources.asset_status: No training code or weight entry identified in the checked original paper; external channels not exhaustively searched.
